starting_cash.source: Official FAQ / $10,000 once, persistent balance between matches

team_sizes.source: Official maximum 100 players, three teams. 34/33/33 is this simulation allocation.

score_interval.source: Official FAQ: highest control-zone player presence every 30 seconds earns 1 point

score_target.source: Official FAQ: first team to 100 points wins

hot_cash_multiplier.source: Official TOP QUESTIONS Steam announcement: hot zone doubles cash

hot_presence_multiplier.source: Official TOP QUESTIONS Steam announcement: hot zone doubles presence weight

fob_cost.source: Official S1 patch: FOB vendor price $7,500

hammer_cost.source: Official S1 patch: Large Hammer vendor price $2,400; assumes account has already unlocked it (Support 8 + $75,000 unlock, not charged each life)

loadout_cost.source: Public complete equipment price list not verified. Editable modeling values, NOT official.

rewards.source: Community MetaForge: kill 300/1500/3000, attack/victim location each half; zone 160/320; first entry 250. Other cash rewards unverified model values, not official.

vehicles.source: Historical WARDOGS Hub vendor recordings: Kodiak M249 $3,750 / total 5 seats, SPH-2 $8,000 / total 3, MH-6 $6,250 / total 6. Not verified current S1. seats is passenger capacity excluding driver; armor crew abstracted to one operator. Speed, HP, weapon range are model assumptions. Aircraft use a 2D route model without altitude or collision.

world_size.source: 6x6 km local simulation crop. Official world is 256 km2, with a 2x2 km control zone.

control_zone.source: Official FAQ: 2x2 km control zone; its fixed centered position here is a modeling assumption

hot_radius.source: 250m circle. Exact public radius not verified.

hot_period.source: Continuous 240-second orbital route approximates officially moving hot zone

time_limit.source: 3-hour simulation cutoff only; no winner assigned unless score_target reached

combat.source: Abstract range-based stochastic combat, no official weapon stats, armor penetration, terrain collision, or line-of-sight replication

logistics.source: FOB construction, supply capacity, respawn supply, bleedout, free fallback kit, transport distance and reward timings are editable simulation assumptions

agents.source: Synthetic role-driven policies, not measured real player telemetry or a prediction of actual win rates

cash_interval.source: MetaForge: ~24 seconds, explicitly approximate; independent of official 30-second team scoring.

enable_fob_respawn.source: FOB spawning is not verified. Disabled by default. FOB healing/supply is also an abstract experimental support model.

scope.source: All roles assume equipment already permanently unlocked; no XP/level progression/unlock fee simulation. End-match bonus and population payout scaling are not modeled. Synthetic role preferences are not official class locks.

map_layout.source: Three main bases are approximately 2,500m from center and 120 degrees apart to avoid built-in travel-distance advantage; this is a synthetic research map, not actual geography.
